svg.title: Valdara Industries, Serra 180 – General arrangement (VI-DWG-B180-001)
svg.text: 1 Seat height 450 mm at the front edge of the seat when anchored, with the
frames 10 mm above the plinth on levelling nuts; adjustable
440 to 460 mm (gap 0 to 20 mm, grouted after levelling).
2 Fixed to the ground by four M12 ground anchors (separate item),
two per side frame, through the Ø14 holes in the feet.
3 Slats: 5, 1800 x 95 x 45, thermally modified ash;
3 on the seat (gaps 22), 2 on the back; 20 carriage
bolts M8 x 65, nuts, washers in stainless A2 (A4 at the coast).
4 Overall: 1800 long over the slats, 1660 over the armrests,
620 deep, 780 high. Seat width between the
5 Bench net mass 44.1 kg (frames galvanised and coated).
6 Load: UR-SF-0450, 450 kg on the seat, 1 h, no lasting
deformation; checked also against EN 581-2 (contract use).
see BOM, drawing 005 mass 44.1 kg net
